Package org.apache.juneau.console.views

Class ViewTable

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.views.ViewTable
public class ViewTable extends Object
Public DOM/CSS contract for a data-juneau-view table.

Table authoring is FTL <@card type="datatables"> (JSON5 catalog). This type is the stable set of marker attributes and class names the runtime and consumer chrome still stamp or select: CSRF on a shell ancestor, layout hint, selection/bulk markers, row-detail template attributes, and the named overflow class. It is not a Java page-authoring factory.

See Also:

    • TABLE_CLASS

      public static final String TABLE_CLASS
      Class stamped on every emitted <table> — top-level and nested alike — and the anchor of the toolkit's cell-overflow contract.

      juneau-views.css clips cell content through the named selector .juneau-view-table td rather than a global unnamed td rule, so the contract reaches only tables this toolkit produced and never app markup the toolkit does not own. See CELL_WRAP_CLASS for the opt-out.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • CELL_WRAP_CLASS

      public static final String CELL_WRAP_CLASS
      Per-cell opt-out from the clip/ellipsis default: .juneau-view-table td.juneau-cell-wrap restores the pre-10.0 wrapping behavior.

      The named renderers whose output is a chip / bar / link rather than prose (progress, pill, tag, linked) stamp this themselves through their class facet; an author who wants a wrapping prose column stamps it through that column's own class.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • CSRF_ATTR

      public static final String CSRF_ATTR
      Attribute the CSRF token is stamped into on a shell ancestor (typically <main>) so juneau-views.js can attach it to mutating requests.

      On an allowed request the LoopbackBoundaryFilter publishes the process's CSRF token under LoopbackBoundaryFilter.TOKEN_ATTRIBUTE; the host copies it here. The runtime fails closed when this attribute is absent, empty, or whitespace: it visibly refuses to issue any row-action request rather than sending one the server would 403.

      See Also:

    • DETAIL_ACTION_RULES_ATTR

      public static final String DETAIL_ACTION_RULES_ATTR
      Attribute carrying an ActionRef's row-state rules as a JSON array, in the author's declared order. Omitted entirely for an ungated action.

      Each entry is {"field":..., "op":..., "value"?:..., "reason":...} — the same JSON-in-a-data-attribute shape DETAIL_FIELD_RENDER_META_ATTR uses. Declaration order is the array order, because the first failing rule is the one whose reason an operator sees.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • DETAIL_ACTION_DESC_ATTR

      public static final String DETAIL_ACTION_DESC_ATTR
      Attribute on the hidden node a gated action's disabled reason is painted into, carrying that action's id. Emitted only alongside DETAIL_ACTION_RULES_ATTR.

      The node exists because aria-describedby needs something real to point at. It carries the native HTML hidden attribute rather than a utility class, so no stylesheet rule is needed to keep it out of view and none is added. It carries no element id here either: this whole subtree is cloned per expanded row, so the runtime mints the row-unique one.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • NESTED_ATTR

      public static final String NESTED_ATTR
      Marker attribute on the nested-table wrapper <div> (value "1").

      Nested-table seeding inside a row-detail panel is deferred; this marker remains so a later host can skip auto-init of a nested data-juneau-view table until its pane is visible.

    • NESTED_META_ATTR

      public static final String NESTED_META_ATTR
      Attribute on the nested VIEW_META sidecar <script>, carrying the nested view id.

      The nested sidecar carries no HTML id (a <template> clone would collide); the runtime finds it as a sibling of the nested <table> by this attribute instead.
